definitions.explanation: A raised platform or stand from which a person delivers a speech, lecture, or presentation.

examples.japanese: {議長|ぎちょう}が{演壇|えんだん}から{挨拶|あいさつ}を{述|の}べた。
examples.english: The chairperson gave a greeting from the podium.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}しながら{演壇|えんだん}に{上|あ}がったが、{話|はな}し{始|はじ}めると{落|お}ち{着|つ}いてきた。
examples.english: I nervously stepped up to the podium, but once I started speaking I calmed down.

notes:
A compound of {演|えん} (perform/speech) and {壇|だん} (platform/stage). Refers to the raised area or stand where a speaker addresses an audience.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演壇|えんだん}に{立|た}つ: to stand at the podium
- {演壇|えんだん}に{上|あ}がる: to go up to the podium
- {演壇|えんだん}から{降|お}りる: to step down from the podium
- {演壇|えんだん}で{演説|えんぜつ}する: to give a speech at the podium

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {壇上|だんじょう}: on the stage/platform — refers to the area itself rather than the specific speaking stand
- {講壇|こうだん}: lecture platform — specifically for academic lectures
- {縁談|えんだん}: marriage proposal — a homophone with an unrelated meaning
